subject: SIG questionnaire & DPA / SCCs — clarifications on HIPAA/BAA feasibility
body:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsyshealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@medsyshealth.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG questionnaire & DPA — HIPAA/BAA questions

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Medsys is really excited about Redwood's latency numbers. Legal asked for a few things to keep our procurement moving:

1) Completed SIG Lite (or full SIG if you have one) — they want the spreadsheet where you mark controls and provide evidence links.
2) Draft DPA and confirmation on SCC usage (we operate partly in EU).
3) Topline note on HIPAA/BAA feasibility: can Redwood support a business associate agreement and the controls required (encryption in transit/at rest, key management, audit logs)? If not, what deployment model would?

Do you have a candidate to own the responses? We can give you until end of next week for the SIG; legal is happy to review a draft DPA.

Best,
Liam

---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@medsyshealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: RE: SIG questionnaire & DPA — HIPAA/BAA questions

Hi Liam,

Great to meet you all — glad the demo resonated.

We can own the SIG responses and provide a draft DPA. To set expectations up front: Redwood's hosted product is designed for general-purpose workloads and we provide industry-standard protections (TLS, rest encryption, SOC 2 Type II). For HIPAA/BAA we typically recommend Dedicated or Private deployments because of the extra controls customers usually require (dedicated tenancy, customer-managed keys, specific logging retention). That said, I'll loop in our security and legal folks to give a concrete list of required controls and a recommended path.

I'm attaching our current SIG workbook with initial responses and a DPA draft (work-in-progress) so your team can review.

Attachments: redwood_SIG_responses_v1.xlsx (SIG answers, highlighted items to confirm), DPA_draft_v2.pdf (initial template).

I'll follow up after internal review — can we tentatively target next Wednesday for a detailed response?

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Lead | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG questionnaire & DPA — HIPAA/BAA questions

Team — forwarding Medsys. Key asks are SIG, DPA, and a quick feasibility note on BAA support. I started the SIG workbook but left several technical/legal callouts highlighted. Please see the attached workbook and DPA draft.

Can you each take a pass on your areas and reply with: 
- items that require evidence (S3 bucket links, SOC 2 report, KMS diagrams)
- anything we cannot commit to for hosted product (call out clearly)
- recommended deployment/path for HIPAA customers (Dedicated vs Private + specifics)

Target: consolidated reply by EOD Tues (US). If you need more time, flag it here.

Thanks — Hannah

--- Forwarded message attached ---

Attachments included: redwood_SIG_responses_v1.xlsx, DPA_draft_v2.pdf

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 07:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG questionnaire & DPA — HIPAA/BAA questions

Hannah / Priyom — taking the technical pass. Quick notes pulled into the SIG workbook (column 'tech_notes'):

- Encryption: We provide TLS1.2+ in transit and AES-256 at rest for hosted. For Hosted API the keys are managed by Redwood KMS; for Dedicated/Private we offer customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS/HSM) — documented in architecture_kms_diagram.png.
- Audit logs: request/response metadata and system-level logs exist; retention configurable for Dedicated/Private. Default hosted retention = 30 days (extendable as add-on).
- Data residency/SCCs: We can route EU traffic to EU region and execute SCCs in the DPA. For third-party subprocessors, we have a standard list with subprocessors.csv (I linked in the workbook).
- Model handling: note on KV cache — we do not persist user prompts in training pipelines; we have an option to disable persistent telemetry for regulated customers.

Outstanding technical gaps (items where evidence is required):
- Extractable audit log examples (we can provide anonymized sample logs).
- KMS proof-of-possessions/configuration steps for customer-managed keys.
- Network segmentation evidence for Dedicated pools.

I'll attach the diagram and add links to evidence in the SIG sheet.

-David

--
David Kim
Staff SRE, Platform Security | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0138

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG questionnaire & DPA — HIPAA/BAA questions

Hannah / David — legal and compliance pass below. High level:

1) DPA / SCCs: We can sign a DPA and incorporate EU SCCs. I attached a redline-ready DPA_draft_v2.pdf and flagged language that the procurement team often wants changed (liability caps, subprocessors list, breach notification SLAs).

2) SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II in scope; I'll pull the latest report but will only share under NDA / secure link. That counts as primary evidence for many SIG items.

3) HIPAA / BAA feasibility: Redwood does not currently operate a hosted product with an offer that includes a BAA. Practically, we can support HIPAA-covered workloads via: 
   - Dedicated (reserved capacity) with customer-managed KMS + additional logging and contractual commitments, or
   - Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) where customer controls key custody and network boundaries.

If Medsys requires BAA, we'll need: 
   - commitment to Dedicated or Private deployment
   - signed DPA with explicit BAA language (we'll draft),
   - standard onboarding checklist: network config, key escrow decisions, retention SLAs, and a security configuration attestation.

Next steps I recommend: legal redline of the attached DPA (I've marked three sections for negotiation), David to confirm availability of the audit log sample & KMS guide, and Hannah to align on timeline with Medsys procurement.

-Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0177

Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: RE: SIG questionnaire & DPA — HIPAA/BAA questions

Hi Liam / Claire — thanks for the patience. Quick consolidated update and next steps: 

1) SIG workbook: attached is the completed workbook with evidence links and tech/legal comments (redwood_SIG_responses_v1.xlsx). Items requiring secure artifact delivery (SOC 2 report, sample logs) are flagged with secure links; Priyom will provide SOC 2 under NDA.

2) DPA & SCCs: we've attached a draft DPA (DPA_draft_v2.pdf) with proposed SCC inclusion. Our legal team has redlined three negotiation points: liability cap, subprocessors list process, and breach notification timing. Priyom is on the thread to negotiate.

3) HIPAA / BAA: summary — we can support HIPAA-covered workloads, but only on Dedicated or Private deployments with customer-managed KMS and the onboarding checklist items (network segmentation, longer log retention, attestation). Redwood currently does NOT offer a hosted BAA for the standard multi-tenant hosted product.

Next steps I propose:
- Please confirm if Medsys is willing to evaluate Dedicated or Private for this engagement.
- If yes: we'll schedule a technical call (David) to walkthrough KMS/architecture (suggest Wed 17th or Thu 18th PT).
- Priyom will share the redline DPA and a proposed BAA addendum for your counsel to review.

Links/Attachments included: redwood_SIG_responses_v1.xlsx, DPA_draft_v2.pdf, architecture_kms_diagram.png

Would you like to schedule the tech call now? Neha, please coordinate the meeting if Medsys confirms.

Best,
Hannah
